column4: UPGRADE of a stale partial row. The row still says "the cited carrier proves only the one instance in scope here, R=L_F2(1,2)"; that was true before commit a86b934c7, which landed GroupApproximation/Leavitt/AryPurelyInfinite.lean. AryLeavitt.isPurelyInfiniteSimpleRing proves the printed adjective in the Ara-Goodearl-Pardo idempotent form (MFQuotientUnits.IsPurelyInfiniteSimpleRing) for EVERY field k and EVERY d >= 2, with no Ara-Goodearl-Pardo input. The d >= 2 hypothesis is the paper's own standing convention (tex line 1248, "let d >= 2") and is necessary, not a weakening: L_k(1,1) = k[x,x^-1] is commutative and not simple. Lane o-preusser 2026-09-09.

Replaces the previous carrier list, whose own note conceded that the Preusser application "is cited, not covered by the named declarations", and that pure infiniteness and the exchange property were carried only by their operative reading (single-sandwich division). All three printed steps are now proved as printed. manuscriptSentence_purelyInfiniteSimpleIsExchange is Ara's theorem at full generality: every purely infinite simple unital ring is an exchange ring, in Nicholson's element-wise form (GroupApproximation.IsExchangeRing, Algebra/ExchangeRing.lean). binaryLeavitt_isPurelyInfiniteSimpleRing and binaryLeavitt_isExchangeRing instantiate the first two clauses at R = L_k(1,2) for every field. manuscriptSentence_rankFourSandwich is the printed conclusion at the printed rank: for EVERY subgroup N of GL_4(L_F2(1,2)) normalized by EL_4, there is exactly one two-sided ideal I with EL_4(R,I) <= N <= C_4(R,I); it is a closed Prop and every citation in the sentence is discharged. manuscriptSentence_preusserSandwichForExchangeRings is the same at the source's generality (any exchange ring, n >= 3). Lane o-preusser 2026-09-09.

Adds the literal centre computation the sentence cites. BinaryLeavitt.center_eq_bot is Z(L_k(1,2)) = k, hence Z(R) = F_2 at k = ZMod 2, the printed Aranda Pino-Crow Corollary 4.3 clause. manuscriptSentence_leavittCentreIsBaseField (GroupApproximation/Leavitt/LeavittCenter.lean) generalises it to every arity: the centre of L_k(1,d) is k for every field k and every d >= 2, proved from the monomial normal form and the d-ary kill-word sandwich, not cited. The two previously named sentence_ carriers are retained: they are the consequences the printed proof actually uses (every central unit is trivial, hence N = 1). Lane o-preusser 2026-09-09.

Only landed declarations are named here. Lane o-preusser 2026-09-09.

Was graded attribution with no declarations, but the sentence asserts a mathematical equivalence, not a credit. manuscriptSentence_korchaginFullSequenceSeparation states it: for countable G, IsOperatorMF G (the printed definition, whose separation clause is a limsup with a constant that may depend on g) holds if and only if there is a WeakMFApproximation, a sequence of finite unitary models carrying ONE positive separation constant valid for every pair of distinct elements at every large index. That is exactly "along the full sequence with a constant independent of g". The forward half was already in the tree (exists_weakMFApproximation); the converse had no statement, and isNormApproximable_of_weakMFApproximation in the same module supplies it. Lane o-preusser 2026-09-09.

The property (T) clause is manuscriptSentence_pairSubringElementaryPropertyT: for ANY two ring elements the subring they generate is a finitely generated ring and EL_3 over it has property (T), by the formalized Ershov-Jaikin-Zapirain theorem, with no hypothesis at all, not even ts = 1.
